from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib, re, json
published='fd17d9f1b3931eb2b974b86ccc5a3892da47ba33'
upstream='138b1356495bb3a2c9b35020240513f8faa84964'
app_path='apps/web/src/App.tsx'
provider_path='apps/web/src/SourceWorkbench.tsx'
app=Path(app_path).read_text()
provider=Path(provider_path).read_text()
def from_git(ref,path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+path],text=True)
prior=from_git(published,app_path)
main=from_git(upstream,app_path)
prior_provider=from_git(published,provider_path)
def block(text,start,end):
    i=text.index(start)
    return text[i:text.index(end,i)]
checks={}
for label,start,end,parent in [
 ('App host and embedded dispatch preserved from upstream','export function App(','\nfunction ConversationWorkspace',main),
 ('Canonical pane selection preserved from upstream','  const mainPlacement=','  const modelThread',main),
 ('Candidate and detached thread selection preserved from upstream','  const candidateThread =','  const customConversationLayout=',main),
 ('Split view rendering, conditional root, and layout error branches preserved from upstream','  const renderConversationView=','  const interfaceFont',main),
 ('Source journal and workspace handoff preserved from published M15','  const prepareSourceJournal=','  const updateCanvasPanel',prior),
]:
    checks[label]=block(app,start,end)==block(parent,start,end)
checks['SourceWorkbenchProvider body preserved from published M15']=block(provider,'export function SourceWorkbenchProvider','export function SourceMessage')==block(prior_provider,'export function SourceWorkbenchProvider','export function SourceMessage')
checks['SourceMessage and WorkbenchComposer preserved from published M15']=block(provider,'export function SourceMessage','function WorkbenchDialog')==block(prior_provider,'export function SourceMessage','function WorkbenchDialog')
artifact_active=lambda text: re.findall(r'<Artifact\b[^>]*?active=\{([^}]+)\}',text)
checks['Both active Artifact predicates preserve canonical resolvedMainId']=artifact_active(app)==artifact_active(main)==['thread?.id===resolvedMainId','thread?.id===resolvedMainId']
def fallback_summary(text):
    value=block(text,'    <SummaryLayout active={!embeddedThreadId','<div ref={findScope}')
    return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',re.sub(r'<SourceWorkbenchProvider\b[^>]*>','',value)).strip()
checks['Fallback SummaryLayout props preserved with provider insertion only']=fallback_summary(app)==fallback_summary(main)
checks['No additional Composer element introduced']=len(re.findall(r'<Composer\b',app))==len(re.findall(r'<Composer\b',main))==2
result={
 'kind':'read-only App merge review',
 'publishedParent':published,
 'upstreamParent':upstream,
 'sourceSha256':{path:hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in [app_path,provider_path,'apps/web/src/WorkbenchPanelContent.tsx','apps/web/src/WorkActivity.tsx']},
 'checks':checks,
 'status':'PASS' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL',
 'limits':'Exact block comparisons plus manual structural review; no browser launched, no runtime identity claim added.'
}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(checks.values()) else 1)
